schema.content:
Table "countries" {
  "COUNTRY_ID" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "COUNTRY_NAME" TEXT
  "REGION_ID" TEXT
}

Table "departments" {
  "DEPARTMENT_ID" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "DEPARTMENT_NAME" TEXT [not null]
  "MANAGER_ID" TEXT
  "LOCATION_ID" TEXT
}

Table "employees" {
  "EMPLOYEE_ID" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "FIRST_NAME" TEXT
  "LAST_NAME" TEXT [not null]
  "EMAIL" TEXT [not null]
  "PHONE_NUMBER" TEXT
  "HIRE_DATE" DATE [not null]
  "JOB_ID" TEXT [not null]
  "SALARY" TEXT
  "COMMISSION_PCT" TEXT
  "MANAGER_ID" TEXT
  "DEPARTMENT_ID" TEXT
}

Table "job_history" {
  "EMPLOYEE_ID" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "START_DATE" DATE [pk, not null]
  "END_DATE" DATE [not null]
  "JOB_ID" TEXT [not null]
  "DEPARTMENT_ID" TEXT
}

Table "jobs" {
  "JOB_ID" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "JOB_TITLE" TEXT [not null]
  "MIN_SALARY" TEXT
  "MAX_SALARY" TEXT
}

Table "locations" {
  "LOCATION_ID" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "STREET_ADDRESS" TEXT
  "POSTAL_CODE" TEXT
  "CITY" TEXT [not null]
  "STATE_PROVINCE" TEXT
  "COUNTRY_ID" TEXT
}

Table "regions" {
  "REGION_ID" TEXT [pk, not null]
  "REGION_NAME" TEXT
}



Ref: "countries"."REGION_ID" > "regions"."REGION_ID"

Ref: "employees"."JOB_ID" > "jobs"."JOB_ID"

Ref: "employees"."DEPARTMENT_ID" > "departments"."DEPARTMENT_ID"

Ref: "job_history"."JOB_ID" > "jobs"."JOB_ID"

Ref: "job_history"."DEPARTMENT_ID" > "departments"."DEPARTMENT_ID"

Ref: "job_history"."EMPLOYEE_ID" > "employees"."EMPLOYEE_ID"

Ref: "locations"."COUNTRY_ID" > "countries"."COUNTRY_ID"
